comments.author: SrMangueirao
comments.body_html: I’ve been waiting for a mod like this that isn’t OP. A request/question: would it be possible to add a toggle key for the IFF? When it’s always on, aiming near a wall sometimes reveals whether a bot is on the other side; I’d like to see if I can identify friendly PMCs (using pit fireteam) to recruit during a raid without resorting to a “wallhack.” Regardless, it’s an excellent mod—simple yet incredibly powerful.

comments.author: maschine
comments.body_html:
Sure thing, I’ll add an extra activation method via hotkey.
I’m also implementing a toggle that displays only friendly units. That way, the mod can stay active all the time to prevent you from accidentally shooting your PIT Fireteam teammates.

comments.body_html:
I’ve actually never looked into fika before, but this is a good reason to do so 😄.
